verdict.rationale: llamafile is a local LLM inference runtime, so accelerator support is a fair axis. The evidence documents only GPU acceleration for Apple Metal, NVIDIA, AMD and Vulkan, plus CPU inference. Nothing in the pack mentions TPUs, Gaudi or any plugin mechanism for adding specialized accelerator backends, and GPU support is a related but different capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on specialized accelerators like TPUs or Gaudi through plugin support
